title: Product-vector support characterizes finite stochastic marginal-return preparation
reported_status: The supplied report presents a complete finite-dimensional criterion for stochastic marginal-return preparation of a bipartite state: existence is claimed exactly when the target support contains a product vector. It also reports a finite catalyst construction, a probability-independent converse, a failure of transitivity, a capped-reservoir approximation example, and a product-return criterion. This intake preserved the report only; the linked verification code/results were not supplied and no proof was independently reconstructed. Correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN. No historic-scale breakthrough is claimed.
scientific_scope_status: Finite-dimensional bipartite state preparation from separable inputs using an arbitrary, possibly mixed, finite bipartite catalyst and a successful LOCC branch of probability p>0. The success-conditioned catalyst marginal is returned exactly, while the joint output–catalyst state may be correlated; failure is unrestricted. The reported necessity applies to every finite catalyst, every p>0, and separable operations. The construction uses local catalyst dimensions at most d_A+1 and d_B+1. It is not a universally usable channel implementation or a composable state relation.
